From: Amanda Cole <amanda.cole@skybound.ai>

Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Rapid Recovery retainer packaging and pricing

Hi Marissa,

We're evaluating support options for a new critical path feature at Skybound and I wanted to get a clearer picture of Redwood's 'rapid recovery' style retainer. Specifically:

- What uptime tiers do you offer (SLA % by region) and how do credits scale?
- Response time windows for P1/P2/P3 (and guaranteed callback vs triage)?
- Does the retainer include dedicated on-call coverage or just prioritized queues?
- What are options for monthly vs annual billing and any pilot discounts for a 3-month POC?
- Are there escalation matrices (engineering handoffs, percent coverage during major incidents)?

We have a potential $600k ARR if the POC goes well; pricing and clear escalation behavior will be a big factor. Can you share a simple price/coverage matrix and any sample SOW language?

Thanks — appreciate a short summary and any attachments you can share.

Amanda Cole
Head of Procurement, Skybound AI
Amanda.Cole@skybound.ai

Attachment: procurement-requirements-2027.pdf (referenced)

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>

Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rapid Recovery retainer packaging and pricing

Amanda — thanks for the clear list. Short version below and I attached a compact pricing workbook + term sheet for your legal/finance review. Happy to hop on a 30m call after you look.

High-level retainer options (summary):

- Bronze (Core): $8,500/mo — 99.5% regional uptime target, P1 response < 4 hours, prioritized queue (no dedicated on-call). Credits: prorated for downtime > 1hr.
- Silver (Assured): $22,000/mo — 99.9% uptime, P1 response < 2 hours, 4-hour guaranteed engineering engagement SLA, includes quarterly runbooks review. Credits escalate on repeated incidents.
- Gold (Rapid Recovery): $43,000/mo (list) — 99.95% uptime, P1 response < 60 minutes, guaranteed engineering phone callback within 30 minutes, includes scheduled on-call rotation assigned to your account (not exclusive) and post-incident RCA support. Credits matrix attached.

Pilot / POC concession:
- For a 3-month pilot we can offer a 20% discount off the first quarter for Silver or Gold to reduce friction to start.
- Pilot includes a scoped SOW (attached) and 2 knowledge-transfer sessions.

Escalation coverage:
- Level 1: CS triage (business hours) -> Level 2: Platform Eng (on-call rotation) -> Level 3: L3 Eng + Eng Manager (escalated incidents).
- During a declared Major Incident we commit a named on-call engineer for the duration under Gold and weekly status reports until resolved.

Billing & terms: monthly or annual (annual gets 10% credit). Terms in term-sheet.

I've attached: RR-Retainer-Pricing-v1.xlsx (pricing matrix), redwood-sla-term-sheet.pdf (term + credits).

If you'd like I can present this to your procurement/legal next Tue or Wed.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Offer summary (approved):
- Gold (Rapid Recovery) promotional rate: $34,400/mo for the first 3 months (20% off list), then returns to $43,000/mo thereafter.
